glosses: mushroom

examples.text: грибно́й суп
грибно́й дождь
Карто́фельный суп мо́жно гото́вить не то́лько на мясно́м, но и на ры́бном или грибно́м бульо́не.
examples.translation: Potato soup may be cooked not only with the meat broth but also with fish or mushroom broth
examples.english: Potato soup may be cooked not only with the meat broth but also with fish or mushroom broth

glosses: относящийся к грибу, грибам

examples.text: И, с аппетитом хлебая молочную лапшу, он долго рассказывал о грибных местах, мшистых полянках, частых ельниках…
В грибном лесу одна полянка другой полянке руку подает через кусты, и когда эти кусты переходишь, на полянке тебя встречает твой гриб.
Примерно с середины лета, когда приходят жаркие дни и частенько гремят грозы, начинается грибная пора.

glosses: приготовленный из грибов, с грибами

examples.text: Дома были приготовлены котлеты и грибной суп.
Марина, склонясь над огнём, мешала грибную похлёбку.
На столе перед иноком действительно стояли две тарелки с остатками грибного соуса и отваренных плодов.

glosses: Any of the fleshy fruiting bodies of fungi typically produced above ground on soil or on their food sources (such as decaying wood).

examples.text: Some mushrooms are edible and taste good, while others are poisonous and taste foul.
Arabs consider the eating of mushrooms as an aphrodisiac aid.

glosses: A fungus producing such fruiting bodies.
Champignon or Agaricus bisporus, the mushroom species most commonly used in cooking.
Any of the mushroom-shaped pegs in bar billiards.
A concrete column with a thickened portion at the top, used to support a slab.
One who rises suddenly from a low condition in life; an upstart.

examples.text: upstarts […]call in reproach mushrooms

glosses: Something that grows very quickly or seems to appear suddenly.

examples.text: The craze [hula hoops] began in the U.S.A., and in October the boom crossed the Atlantic and 40 firms sprang into being, some being overnight mushrooms.

glosses: Ellipsis of mushroom cloud.
Having characteristics like those of a mushroom, for example in shape or appearance, speed of growth, or texture.

examples.text: mushroom cloud

glosses: To grow quickly to a large size or rapidly increase in scope or scale.

examples.text: The town’s population mushroomed from 10,000 to 110,000 in five years.
In Beilu Village of Liucun Town in Yaodu District, Linfen, abnormal illnesses continued to emerge, as a result of clusters of highly-polluting enterprises mushrooming in the vicinity.
The world's population of ultra-high-net-worth individuals, a super-elite with assets of at least $30m, has now mushroomed beyond 250,000 people, all in need of somewhere to store their wealth.
It has its own global news gathering and sharing platforms, like Facebook, YouTube and Twitter. […] In recent years, all these platforms have mushroomed.

glosses: To gather mushrooms.

examples.text: We used to go mushrooming in the forest every weekend.

glosses: To form the shape of a mushroom.

examples.text: Excessive spot weld time may cause the electrode tips to mushroom, resulting in no focus of current and a weak weld.

glosses: To form the shape of a mushroom.
To form the shape of a mushroom when striking a soft target.
